Hi Eliza — thanks for the details and the prioritized worksheet. Below are concise answers to the items you flagged; happy to expand on the call Wednesday.

Summary answers (high level):
- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II certified. Coverage period: Jan 1, 2025 — Dec 31, 2025. Full report attached and evidence bundle available in the Drive link above.

- Backups & KMS: Backups are customer-scoped and encrypted at rest. We use per-customer KMS keys for Dedicated and Private deployments; for Hosted accounts we use tenant-specific keys managed in our KMS with strict separation. Backups are immutable snapshots by default for the last 30 days (snapshot-based immutability), and archived backups are retained up to 365 days depending on customer profile and contract.

- Deletion SLA & propagation: Primary data deletion is executed immediately on request. For hosted accounts we guarantee deletion from primary stores within 24 hours. Propagation to backups follows the snapshot lifecycle: snapshots are immutable for 30 days (cannot be altered), after which they are eligible for purge. For customers requiring immediate purge from backups we offer a contractual Data Erasure SLA (often 30 days from request) and can negotiate tighter windows in Dedicated/Private plans.

- Log retention: Default audit/log retention is 90 days. We support extended retention (12–24 months) for audit logs via configuration or as a paid add-on — many enterprise customers opt for 12 months. We can include a config snippet and pricing in the follow-up.

- HIPAA/PII notes: We support BAA on enterprise contracts. Access controls, encryption in transit and at rest, and audit logging are in place. For HIPAA-sensitive data we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments for additional isolation and key control.

Action items / next steps:
1) We'll complete the vendor questionnaire (Rishi + security team) and upload answers to the Drive folder by EOD Wednesday (11/18).
2) Vanessa to share the SOC2 PDF to your security folder and add our evidence bundle link.
3) If HealthTech needs a Data Erasure SLA or amended retention window, loop in your procurement and we can scope in the contract (Rishi + Contracts).
4) On the Wednesday call: walk through items 7–12 and confirm whether you want extended log retention and a proposed table of costs.
